title: TQI Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: Texas Quantum Initiative, The University of Texas at Austin
about: The Texas Quantum Initiative at The University of Texas at Austin, United States, offers a two-year TQI Postdoctoral Fellowship open to incoming and current UT postdoctoral fellows. Applications for the next cycle are due 31 January 2027; contact TQI-OE@utexas.edu.
requirements: Incoming or current UT Austin postdoctoral fellows
